question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A state of disuse or inactivity'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Desuetude)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Desuetude"** means a state of disuse or inactivity. (अप्रचलन या निष्क्रियता)
 
 
• **Example:** The old factory fell into desuetude after the company relocated to another city.
 

 
• **"Desuetude"** is the correct word to describe something that is no longer in use or has become inactive. (अप्रचलन)
 
 
• **Example:** This law has fallen into desuetude as society has moved on to more progressive policies.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Desuetude)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hiatus** (अंतराल): A pause or gap in a sequence, series, or process.
 
 
• **Example:** The show went on hiatus for the summer but resumed in the fall.
 

 
• **Oblivion** (भूलने की अवस्था): The state of being unaware or unconscious of what is happening around one; or being forgotten.
 
 
• **Example:** His groundbreaking work fell into oblivion after his death.
 

 
• **Interregnum** (अंतराल): A period when normal government is suspended, especially between successive reigns or regimes.
 
 
• **Example:** There was an interregnum of two years before the new king was crowned.
